model_output.verdict: A distribution supervisor with a clear progression and team size, but few results attached to the work.
write_up: Your resume follows a clear path from order picker to outbound shift supervisor. A recruiter can see the kind of operation you run and how many people you supervise. The main question is what changed under your supervision, especially around labor, safety and outbound flow.

The line about supervising 35 associates across picking, packing and loading is your best model: it puts the people and their work together. Your work history and certifications are easy to find, and the dates make your progression easy to follow.
Start with the labor scheduling line. Add the order volume you planned for if you can document it, then show what you taught new leads and what part of the scanner rollout was yours.

cards.line: - Schedule labor and assign zones based on daily order volume
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see how you make the assignments, but not the order volume you plan for. That helps show how much work the shift handles.

cards.line: - Train new leads on the warehouse management system
cards.cannot_tell: Training new leads is useful work. The missing piece is what you taught them to do in the system.

cards.line: - Helped roll out handheld scanners on the pick floor
